editing: Real automated EIP-1193 wallet browser recordings. Cuts remove idle waits; speed changes disclosed. Captions only, no founder impersonation.

scenes.caption:
RetroPick: the market creation layer for Monad.
Token issuance → price discovery → Kuru secondary trading.

Create an ERC20. Quote: MON. Venue: Kuru.
Launch policy is immutable before public bonding.

Buy on the bonding curve, then sell.
Real wallet transactions confirmed on Monad Testnet.

Complete the sellable allocation. Bonding closes.
Completion uses exact integer arithmetic and a generic ceiling.

Secure launch assets to the Graduation Coordinator.
GRADUATING is durable; anyone can complete or retry.

Complete Kuru graduation. Actual market and vault created.
LP shares and excess tokens enter permanent protected custody.

Wallet B places a post-only sell order: 1 RPE2E at 0.00399 MON.
Kuru emits OrderCreated; the resting ask appears.

Wallet A deposits MON into Kuru trading funds.
Trading deposits are separate from protected graduation liquidity.

Wallet A buys at 0.00399 MON, filling Wallet B’s order.
Trade event proves two-wallet execution on the actual market.

Wallet B places another sell order.
The new OrderCreated event returns order ID 2.

Wallet B cancels order ID 2.
OrdersCanceled confirms cancellation; the resting ask disappears.

Launch Proof: market, vault, immutable venue and permanent LP lock.
Testnet candidate; unaudited. Circle live smoke remains blocked by funding.

RetroPick originates markets. Monad settles. Kuru executes.
Public source, verified contracts and transaction evidence are linked beside this video.
